lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓，石缝间爬行的声响。
lines.en: Click click, the sound of scurrying on the rock crack.
The turtle shell glitters under the sun.
Slowly crawling in the rock crevices.

lines.zh: 寻找着可以遮蔽的阴凉处。
lines.en: Seeking a shady place for shelter.

lines.zh: 脚步声轻，避免惊动同伴。
lines.en: Step softly to avoid startling companions.

lines.zh: 慢慢移动，壳内生机盎然。
lines.en: Moving slowly, full of life inside the shell.
Carefully crawling along the rock cracks.

lines.zh: 跟着主人，一步也不落下。
lines.en: I follow my owner and never fall behind.

lines.zh: 四只短腿倒得很快，别笑。
lines.en: My four short legs move fast; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 从商人手里换来的蛋，孵出了我。
lines.en: An egg traded from the merchant hatched me.

lines.zh: 地面硬，我的腹甲擦得响。
lines.en: The ground is hard, and my plastron scrapes loudly.

lines.zh: 静静躺在石头上晒太阳。
lines.en: Lying quietly on the stone, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 静静等待，耐心寻找机会。
lines.en: Quietly waiting, patiently looking for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 乌龟壳上的纹路清晰可见。
lines.en: The turtle shell's patterns are clearly visible.

lines.zh: 龟壳中的生活悄然无声。
lines.en: Life within the shell is silent.
Shell tightly closed, waiting for an opportunity.
Slowly moving, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 我把头缩进去，只留一条缝。
lines.en: I pull my head in, leaving only a slit.

lines.zh: 主人坐着，我就趴在脚边。
lines.en: When my owner sits, I lie at their feet.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路，一年长一圈。
lines.en: The pattern on my shell grows one ring a year.

lines.zh: 晒够了就慢慢挪回阴影。
lines.en: Once I have sunned enough, I shuffle back to the shade.

lines.zh: 被驯服以后，我不乱跑了。
lines.en: Since being tamed, I no longer wander off.
Seeing you, curiosity in the shell.
Looking at you, sharp eyes in the shell.

lines.zh: 我把脖子缩回壳里，又伸出来。
lines.en: I pull my neck into my shell, then out again.
Seeing you, the shell's eyes gleam.

lines.zh: 向你点头，壳内微微震动。
lines.en: Nodding towards you, the shell slightly shakes.
Observing you with the eyes in the shell.
Shell tightly closed, but eyes like torches.
Slowly turning its head in the shell.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察你的一举一动。

lines.en: Buying turtle spawn eggs? I have some.
Do you have a leaf in your hand?
I stretch my neck and still cannot reach you.
Crouch down so I can see you properly.

lines.zh: 你是我的主人吗？我记得味道。
lines.en: Are you my owner? I remember the smell.
Do not tap my shell; it echoes for a while.

lines.zh: 壳沿下面，我的眼睛转了一下。
lines.en: Under the shell rim, my eye rolls toward you.
When you come close, I stop pulling my head in.
What are you waiting for? So am I.

lines.zh: 这一下，壳上又多一道白痕。
lines.en: That blow added another white mark to my shell.

lines.zh: 别看我，我是卖肉的，不是卖菜的！
吃点燕麦吧，保证营养丰富！
不吃胡萝卜，我可不喂你！
lines.en: No carrots, no food from me!

lines.zh: 看我长满鳞片的背壳，安全可靠！
lines.en: My scaled back is safe and reliable!

lines.zh: 不吃胡萝卜，我就用硬壳打你！
看看我的壳，是不是很坚固？
lines.en: Check out my shell, pretty tough!

lines.zh: 吃点燕麦，保证你一天不饿！
lines.en: Some oats, keep you full all day!

lines.zh: 别看我丑，我可是个好伙计！
给我点胡萝卜，我可是个好交易！
硬壳碰硬壳，我们来个亲密接触！
lines.en: Shell to shell, a tight embrace!

lines.zh: 别撞我，我好心提醒一下！
我有硬壳，想撞我？门都没有！
lines.en: Hard shell, you want to crash into me? No way!

lines.zh: 你小心点，别撞到我的壳！
lines.en: Be careful, don’t bump my shell!

lines.zh: 想撞我？你得先过我的壳！
lines.en: Try to bump me, you’ll face my shell!

lines.zh: 小心我的硬壳，别撞坏了！
lines.en: Careful with my shell, don’t break it!

lines.zh: 硬壳很坚硬，你撞不动的！
lines.en: Shell is hard, you can’t bump it!

lines.zh: 找我做伴吧，我不会攻击你！
lines.en: Come mate with me, no attack!

lines.zh: 我是和平使者，来吧，做伴吧！

lines.en: Looking for a mate? I’m your guy!

lines.zh: 我不会攻击你，来吧，做伴！
lines.en: No attack, come mate with me!
Need a mate? Look at me!

lines.zh: 我的壳够厚，能替你挡雨。
lines.en: My shell is thick enough to shelter you from rain.
I eat grass, so I'm peaceful.
Turtle shell is the best music.

lines.zh: 我的壳有自我修复能力。
咔嚓一声咬下你的盔甲！
用乌龟的牙齿留下痕迹！

lines.en: My bite can break the shell.

lines.zh: 咬破你的防备，感受龟力！
lines.en: Break your defenses with turtle power.
Engrave your armor with my teeth.

lines.zh: 龟壳的厚度，你的实力无法穿透！
lines.en: My shell is thicker than your strength.

lines.zh: 咬碎你的骨骼，享受我的力量！
lines.en: Crush your bones with my strength.

lines.zh: 咔哒一声，乌龟破壳而出！
孵化的新生命，坚硬的壳！
lines.en: A new life, a hard shell.

lines.zh: 从蛋中，新生的乌龟诞生！
lines.en: A turtle born from the egg.

lines.zh: 在阳光下，乌龟缓缓孵化！
lines.en: A turtle hatches in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 蛋中的力量，催生新生命！
lines.en: A new life from the egg's strength.

lines.zh: 孵化出的乌龟，坚不可摧！

lines.en: Break out and greet the new world.

lines.zh: 壳中蕴藏的生命，破壳而出！
lines.en: Life from within the shell hatches.

lines.zh: 乌龟的新生命，从蛋开始！
lines.en: A turtle's new life begins in the egg.

lines.zh: 坚硬外壳下的新生力量！
lines.en: New power from the hard shell.
